compute_topk_accuracy: compute top-k classification accuracy from logits and labels using JAX
compute_softmax_cross_entropy: compute softmax cross entropy loss from logits and one-hot labels with configurable reduction
l2_normalize_tensor: l2 normalize a JAX tensor along a specified axis with numerical stability
compute_regression_loss: compute BYOL regression loss as squared L2 distance between l2-normalized vectors
compute_l2_weight_regularizer: compute l2 weight regularization for model parameters excluding biases and norm layers
